requirements_summary: Primary: multi-tenant SaaS support assistant + on-site doc search reranking for customer portals. Latency target: 95th pctile < 450ms for chat flows; throughput target: steady 12-15 QPS, burst to 30 QPS. Cost sensitivity: mid-high (want to keep unit token cost predictable). Must support SSO/SAML, audit logs, EU data residency for subset of accounts. Prefer model family compatible with open/quantized variants; need routing to cheaper variant for low-priority workloads.
